product.title: Private English Wine Tour from Kent

description.text: In London, Thanks to growing conditions similar to those in northern France, southern England’s burgeoning wine scene has never been more promising or accomplished—and this private tour makes it easy to sample and discover more. After pickup from a location of your choosing, you’ll travel in a comfortable minibus to at least three of Kent’s top wineries, where you’ll tour the vineyards and cellars and do plenty of tasting. Stops include Tonbridge Station, Kent Vineyards, English Wine Country. The tour also includes a pub or picnic lunch, per your preference. Ideal for visitors basing in London who want a guided city experience without coordinating Tube routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
